sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Arthur A. Reddy
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Deer Park Avenue between Parkdale Drive and Sylvan Road in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Trooper Arthur B. Reddy.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Babylon to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Babylon to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and the modernization of certain language
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and modernization of certain gendered language.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Gerard B. Kane
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Udall Road in the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to Trooper Gerard B. Kane.

sponsored.t: Changes the dedication of the bridge dedicated to Detective Thomas M. Inman
sponsored.sum: Changes the dedication of the bridge dedicated to Detective Thomas M. Inman.

sponsored.t: Requires electrocardiograms be provided by school health services to screen for heart conditions and requiring electrocardiograms be conducted on students to screen for heart conditions in order to attend school
sponsored.sum: Requires electrocardiograms be provided by school health services to screen for heart conditions; requires electrocardiograms be conducted on students to screen for heart conditions in order to attend school.

sponsored.t: Grants certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Grants certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Raymond J. Averna's Tier III status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Raymond J. Averna's Tier III status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Requires audits by the comptroller in the event of arrest or conviction of contractors
sponsored.sum: Requires audits by the comptroller in the event of arrest or conviction of contractors of certain sections of law relating to theft and fraud.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax deduction for cash and credit card tips received
sponsored.sum: Establishes an income tax deduction for cash and credit card tips received which are considered wages or compensation.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance plans cover annual electrocardiograms for covered children under the age of nineteen
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance plans cover annual electrocardiograms for covered children under the age of nineteen.

sponsored.t: Requires cardiac fitness certificates for interscholastic athletes in all public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires cardiac fitness certificates including an electrocardiogram or echocardiogram for interscholastic athletes in all public schools.

sponsored.t: Requires maternity patients are supplied with an immunization schedule and recommendations for newborns
sponsored.sum: Requires maternity patients are supplied with an immunization schedule and recommendations for newborns.

sponsored.t: Establishes a fine reimbursement credit for taxpayers fined for operating a bar or restaurant during the COVID-19 pandemic
sponsored.sum: Establishes a fine reimbursement credit for taxpayers fined for operating a bar or restaurant during the COVID-19 pandemic in the amount of such fine.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award for which the regular registration fee will apply plus an initial one time service charge of $25.

sponsored.t: Designates August thirty-first as "Overdose Awareness Day"
sponsored.sum: Designates August thirty-first of each year as a day of commemoration to be known as "Overdose Awareness Day"; requires the flag to be flown at half-staff on such date.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring Eagle Scouts
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring the Eagle Scouts for which the regular registration fee will apply plus an initial one time service charge of $25.

sponsored.t: Includes exposing a first responder or correction officer to fentanyl, a fentanyl derivative or an opiate containing fentanyl or fentanyl derivative in the definition of the offense of assault in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes exposing a first responder or correction officer to fentanyl, a fentanyl derivative or an opiate containing fentanyl or a fentanyl derivative in the definition of the offense of assault in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing valid government issued photo identification when casting a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card be presented when casting a ballot; provides for persons eligible for Medicaid to receive identification cards.

sponsored.t: Includes in false registration the attempt to register as an elector knowing that they are not qualified due to lack of U.S. citizenship
sponsored.sum: Includes attempting to register as an elector knowing that they are not qualified due to lack of U.S. citizenship.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a fare refund program for canceled or delayed Long Island Rail Road trains
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a fare refund program for canceled or delayed Long Island Rail Road trains.

sponsored.t: Requires a person in a parental relation to a child be physically present during any immunization
sponsored.sum: Requires a parent, guardian or person in a parental relation to a child under the age of eighteen to be physically present when any immunization is administered to such child.

sponsored.t: Provides for gifts for the support of New York state small businesses
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York small business relief fund to provide grants to small businesses who have suffered economic hardship as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic; provides for a tax write-off for gifts made to such fund.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of unlawful possession of a radio frequency jamming device
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of unlawful possession of a radio frequency jamming device.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful discharge of a loaded firearm toward any police officer, firefighter, corrections officer, peace officer, or emergency medical services personnel
sponsored.sum: Relates to the unlawful discharge of a loaded firearm toward any police officer, firefighter, corrections officer, peace officer, or emergency medical services personnel.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state public sector employee loan forgiveness program
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state public sector employee loan forgiveness program for graduates of SUNY or CUNY schools employed in a state or local public sector position.

sponsored.t: Classifies criminal possession of a firearm from a class E felony to a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Classifies criminal possession of a firearm from a class E felony to a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Requires the purchase of personal protective equipment and medical supplies produced or manufactured in the state of New York in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Requires all contracts over fifty thousand dollars in value made and awarded by any department, agency or authority of the state for the purchase of personal protective equipment or medical supplies shall require that the personal protective equipment or medical supply items be produced or made in whole or substantial part in the state of New York during the existence of a disaster emergency involving an epidemic, pandemic or similar disease outbreak.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary moratorium on unfunded mandates and makes permanent the tax cap
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the enactment of unfunded mandates for a period of three years; instructs the state comptroller to conduct a report on the annual fiscal impact enacted state legislation has on the revenues and expenses of local municipalities.

sponsored.t: Relates to residency restrictions for sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to establish residency restrictions for sex offenders.

sponsored.t: Relates to apprenticeship training
sponsored.sum: Requires that a minimum of ten percent of the labor hours of the total construction workforce employed by all contractors and subcontractors performing work pursuant to a construction contract shall be performed by a person or persons participating in a certified apprenticeship program; makes technical amendments.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a cyber security enhancement fund and restricting the use of taxpayer moneys in paying ransoms
sponsored.sum: Creates a cyber security enhancement fund to be used for the purpose of upgrading cyber security in local governments, including but not limited to, villages, towns and cities with a population of one million or less; restricts the use of taxpayer moneys in paying ransoms in response to ransomware attacks.

sponsored.t: Implements licensure and eligibility limitations for the cannabis control board's social and economic equity plan
sponsored.sum: Implements licensure and eligibility limitations for the cannabis control board's social and economic equity plan regarding persons convicted of certain felonies.

sponsored.t: Provides that people arrested in connection with felonies relating to sex offenses where the victim is less than 13 years old must submit a DNA sample
sponsored.sum: Provides that people arrested in connection with certain felonies must submit a DNA sample.

sponsored.t: Makes permanent certain provisions of chapter 22 of the laws of 2014, relating to expanding opportunities for service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Makes permanent certain provisions relating to expanding opportunities for service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Relates to apprenticeship training
sponsored.sum: Requires such apprenticeship program is specific to the type and scope of work which is being performed and have a graduation rate of at least thirty percent as determined by the department of labor; makes technical corrections.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to pay for certain late fees or fines incurred by state employees
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to pay for late fees or fines incurred by state employees when the legislature and the governor fail to pass a timely state budget and make a provision for state employees to be paid.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictions on authority for the withholding of public monies from educational institutions
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of education may also withhold from any district or city its share of the public money of the state for willfully disobeying any provision of law, or for such decisions, orders or regulations as aforesaid whose willful violation constitutes an immediate threat to the health, safety, education or welfare of students, employees or visitors at such common school, educational institution, school district or public school.

sponsored.t: Relates to the scheduled dredging of navigable waters
sponsored.sum: Requires that regular dredging of navigable waterways is scheduled in order to plan and finance to ensure the safe navigability and reliability of waterways in this state; requires a scheduled plan to be filed with DEC.

sponsored.t: Relates to concealment and/or mutilation of a human corpse
sponsored.sum: Relates to concealment and/or mutilation of a human corpse by any person; exempts practice of funeral direction and organ donation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the custody of defendants who are subject to electronic location monitoring
sponsored.sum: Provides that defendants who are subject to electronic location monitoring are not considered confined or in the custody of the sheriff

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Vets to Vollies" program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Vets to Vollies" program which encourages veterans or discharged military personnel to join their local fire department and emergency medical service agency.

sponsored.t: Establishes a law enforcement, first responder, active and non-active-duty service members and veteran informational mobile application
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of mental health to create and operate a law enforcement, first responder, active and non-active-duty service members and veteran informational mobile application.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Exempts from the mortgage recording tax mortgages executed by a veteran first time homebuyer
sponsored.sum: Exempts from the mortgage recording tax mortgages executed by a veteran first time homebuyer.

sponsored.t: Establishes a penalty for interfering with the repossession of certain vehicles
sponsored.sum: Establishes a penalty for interfering with the repossession of certain collateral vehicles.

sponsored.t: Permits certain schools to provide hemostatic agents for use during emergencies
sponsored.sum: Permits certain schools to provide hemostatic agents for use during emergencies.

sponsored.t: Relates to stopping for a school bus on a public highway with six or more lanes
sponsored.sum: Permits passing a school bus on a public highway with six or more lanes when traveling the opposite direction of the stopped school bus while separated from such school bus by a median or permanent barrier.

sponsored.t: Provides for the revocation of a person's driver's license who has been convicted of operating a vessel while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
sponsored.sum: Provides for the revocation of a person's driver's license who has been convicted of operating a vessel while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to a regional plan for Long Island glass recycling
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to develop a regional plan for Long Island glass recycling in coordination with Alfred university and Long Island municipalities.

sponsored.t: Establishes no school shall serve as a polling place
sponsored.sum: Establishes no polling place shall be located on the premises of any public or private elementary or secondary school or a school for preschool children.

sponsored.t: Relates to admitting evidence of similar crimes in sexual offense cases
sponsored.sum: Permits admission into evidence of similar crimes in sexual offense cases.

sponsored.t: Provides that the list of pre-authoized procedures is to be used only as a list of treatment that does not require insurance carrier approval
sponsored.sum: Simplifies the procedure by which injured workers obtain treatment for injuries covered by the workers' compensation law; provides that the list of pre-authorized procedures is to be used only as a list of treatment that does not require insurance carrier approval.

sponsored.t: Repeals the prohibition on fossil fuel equipment and building systems in new buildings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the prohibition on fossil fuel equipment and building systems in new buildings that is to become effective in 2026.

sponsored.t: Establishes the hydrogen vehicle task force
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority in cooperation with the department of transportation to establish the New York state hydrogen vehicle task force to provide the governor and the legislature with information on the potential effects of expanding the fleet of hydrogen fuel cell vehicles in the state.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on sewage thermal energy
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of sewage thermal energy.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the mental health and prevalence of post-traumatic stress disorder among corrections officers and other prison workers
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the mental health and prevalence of post-traumatic stress disorder among corrections officers and other prison workers and to submit a report of the findings of such study to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the public service commission to evaluate hydrogen, sewage thermal energy, and nuclear small modular reactors as renewable energy sources
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to evaluate hydrogen, sewage thermal energy, and nuclear small modular reactors as renewable energy sources and report the results of such evaluation to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study on the use of small modular reactors
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to conduct a feasibility study and prepare a report on the benefits and implementation of nuclear small modular reactors.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Anthony A. Fede Tier I status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Anthony A. Fede Tier I status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to benefits of temporarily partially disabled workers
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that workers who are temporarily partially disabled are entitled to payment of benefits at a reduced rate unless their separation from employment is unrelated to the compensable injury.

sponsored.t: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department
sponsored.sum: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department.

sponsored.t: Exempts Massapequa school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts Massapequa union free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Requires all vehicles move over or slow down for parked, stopped and standing vehicles on highways and requires at least one question regarding such requirement on the licensing exam
sponsored.sum: Requires all vehicles move over or slow down for parked, stopped and standing vehicles on highways, requiring the inclusion of at least one question regarding such requirement on the state driver's license examination, and requires public education measures on such requirement.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York Jewish Heritage Education Equity Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a committee to conduct a survey of instruction on Jewish heritage and issue a report on such survey.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York Italian American Heritage Education Equity Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a committee to conduct a survey of instruction on Italian American heritage and issue a report on such survey.

sponsored.t: Establishes a committee to conduct a survey of instruction on the history and civic impact of the September eleventh, two thousand one terrorist attacks
sponsored.sum: Establishes a committee to conduct a survey of instruction on the history and civic impact of the September eleventh, two thousand one terrorist attacks and issue a report on such survey.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr.
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr. in the village of Babylon, county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Port Authority Detective Thomas Inman
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Detective Thomas Inman.

sponsored.t: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"
sponsored.ls: Volunteer and Exempt Firefighters' Benevolent Assoc., Inc.
sponsored.sum: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"; changes such association's purpose.
